items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: one of the songs on that date was 'Back Bay Shuffle,' which was a castoff of Chick Webb -- he tried it at rehearsal, but Chick had a orchestra at that time at LaVerg

ctx.x: Your father's parents. And what about your mother's parents?
My mother's parents -- my great grandfather, no it would be my grandfather on my mother's side -- her mother's husband was lost at sea, he was a sea captain. He was a Webb.
Oh, that was his name? Webb?

We did 'Back Bay Shuffle' which was a big hit, on that same date, and it started off with a little thing that I developed with Chick's playing, which is a straight da-da-da, eight bars straight on the cymbal, which became a rage at that time, musically, with some musicians. Instead of a high hat, the same steady beat, you know? Even to this day, Buddy Rich starts his band off that way, on the high hats.
